description: One Nokash merchant contract. Saving it creates the Nokash-<Gateway Name> payment gateway. Payments are in XAF only.

fields.description: Cannot be changed once saved: the payment gateway is named after it.
fields.label: Gateway Name

fields.description: A disabled gateway refuses new payments.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: A Production gateway needs an https:// host_name to send callbacks.
fields.label: Environment

fields.description: Must be an https:// address: the keys are sent to it.
fields.label: API Base URL

fields.description: Sent to Nokash and used to sign each payment request.
fields.label: Integrator Key

fields.description: Sent as the X-NK-Integration header. Nokash gives it for the integration phase and refuses every call without it; leave it empty once the contract is recognised by its address instead.
fields.label: Integration Key

fields.description: With both operators checked, the payer chooses on the payment page.
fields.label: Accept MTN MoMo

fields.description: How long a request may stay pending before the attempt is marked Unresolved.
fields.label: Pending Timeout (Minutes)

fields.description: Smallest amount in XAF a payment request can ask for.
fields.label: Minimum Amount

fields.description: Sends Nokash the address to notify, built from the site's host_name. Nokash only notifies with production keys. The notification only triggers a status check.
fields.label: Send Callback
